lessons.title: Business & Office
lessons.description: Core vocabulary for office operations, documents, facilities, and everyday workplace administration.
lessons.tip: Listen for who is responsible, what document is involved, and any deadline or location mentioned.

words.meaning: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time
words.example: Mina moved her appointment with the regional director to Thursday afternoon.

words.meaning: a local office or part of a larger organization
words.example: The bank's downtown branch will extend its opening hours during tax season.

words.meaning: letters and other written communication exchanged by people or organizations
words.example: Please forward all client correspondence to the new account manager.

words.meaning: a division of an organization responsible for a particular area of work
words.example: The purchasing department approved the replacement chairs.

words.meaning: a list of names, contact details, or other organized information
words.example: The updated staff directory includes each employee's extension number.

words.meaning: the tools or machines needed for a particular activity
words.example: Technicians will inspect the conference-room equipment before the client visit.

words.meaning: a building or place provided for a particular purpose
words.example: The training facility is a short walk from the central office.

words.meaning: a collection of documents stored together; also, to put documents in an organized place
words.vietnameseMeaning: hồ sơ; nộp, lưu hồ sơ
words.example: Please file the signed delivery receipt under the supplier's name.
words.tip: As a verb, file a document; as a noun, a file stores documents.

words.meaning: a printed or digital document with spaces to complete
words.example: New hires must complete the tax form before their first day.

words.meaning: the main office from which an organization is managed
words.example: The product team at headquarters will review the regional sales figures.

words.meaning: a small partitioned area in an office where one person works
words.vietnameseMeaning: bu?ng l?m vi?c nh? trong v?n ph?ng
words.example: The new analyst moved her files into a cubicle beside the customer support team.
words.tip: A cubicle is an individual workspace separated by low partitions.

words.meaning: an office area where incoming and outgoing mail is handled
words.example: Packages for the legal team are waiting in the mailroom.

words.meaning: a short written message used for communication within an organization
words.example: A memo from facilities announced that the elevators will be serviced tonight.

words.meaning: an organized activity or the way a business or system functions
words.vietnameseMeaning: hoạt động; công việc vận hành
words.example: The warehouse operation runs on a reduced schedule during the holiday weekend.

words.meaning: the people who work for an organization
words.example: Only authorized personnel may enter the records room.
words.tip: Usually an uncountable noun referring to staff collectively.

words.meaning: an official rule or principle that guides decisions and actions
words.example: Company policy requires receipts for every travel expense.

words.meaning: an established way of carrying out a task
words.example: Follow the safety procedure before using the document shredder.

words.meaning: the area or desk where visitors are welcomed in an office
words.vietnameseMeaning: quầy lễ tân; khu vực tiếp đón
words.example: Leave the signed contract at reception for Ms. Park to collect.

words.meaning: a person who welcomes visitors and answers calls at an office
words.example: The receptionist called upstairs to let us know the courier had arrived.

words.meaning: stored information about an event, person, or business activity
words.example: The accountant kept a record of every equipment purchase.

words.meaning: materials regularly needed for work
words.example: Order office supplies before the monthly budget closes.

words.meaning: a person who oversees the work of others
words.vietnameseMeaning: người giám sát; quản lý trực tiếp
words.example: Ask your supervisor to approve the revised shift schedule.

words.meaning: a cabinet with drawers for storing organized documents and records
words.example: Facilities placed a lockable filing cabinet near the payroll desks for confidential forms.
words.tip: Filing cabinets are commonly used to organize paper office records.

words.meaning: writing materials such as paper, envelopes, and pens
words.example: The design team ordered letterhead stationery for the new office.
words.tip: Stationery means writing materials; stationary means not moving.

words.meaning: to give or deliver something to several people or places
words.example: The assistant will distribute the updated safety guide to every department.

words.meaning: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
words.example: Building staff maintain the heating system throughout the winter.

words.meaning: to plan a time for an event or task
words.example: We scheduled the network upgrade for after business hours.

words.meaning: to present something for consideration, approval, or processing
words.example: Please submit your mileage claim by the end of the month.

words.meaning: intended to be kept private or secret
words.example: The confidential personnel files are stored in a locked cabinet.

words.meaning: working well without wasting time, effort, or resources
words.example: A shared booking calendar made the equipment checkout process more efficient.

lessons.title: Meetings & Conferences
lessons.description: Words for planning meetings, exchanging ideas, presenting proposals, and recording decisions.
lessons.tip: Meeting questions often test sequence: an item is proposed, discussed, decided, and recorded.

words.meaning: a list of topics to be discussed at a meeting
words.example: The chair circulated the agenda so members could prepare questions in advance.

words.meaning: to end a meeting or formal session
words.example: The committee agreed to adjourn until the revised figures were available.

words.meaning: a person who is present at an event or meeting
words.example: Each attendee received a name badge at the registration desk.

words.meaning: a short meeting or report that gives essential information
words.vietnameseMeaning: buổi họp thông tin; bản tóm lược
words.example: The project lead held a morning briefing on the construction timetable.

words.meaning: a formal meeting, often involving people from different organizations
words.example: The annual conference will bring suppliers together with retail managers.

words.meaning: general agreement reached by a group
words.example: After reviewing the options, the panel reached a consensus on the launch date.

words.meaning: to give ideas, effort, or resources to a shared activity
words.example: Several engineers contributed practical suggestions during the design review.

words.meaning: a formal discussion in which different opinions are presented
words.example: The budget debate continued after the finance director joined the call.

words.meaning: a person chosen to represent others at a meeting or event
words.vietnameseMeaning: đại biểu; người được ủy quyền
words.example: Each regional delegate reported on local customer demand.

words.meaning: a conversation in which people consider a subject together
words.example: The discussion of delivery delays will begin after the safety update.

words.meaning: a person who helps a group work or communicate effectively
words.example: An outside facilitator helped the two teams agree on priorities.

words.meaning: a document given to people at a meeting or class
words.example: The presenter added the revised figures to the handout before printing it.

words.meaning: the main speech at a conference, setting its central theme
words.example: A logistics expert will deliver the keynote on sustainable shipping.

words.meaning: the official written record of what was discussed and decided at a meeting
words.example: Jordan emailed the minutes to all committee members after lunch.
words.tip: Meeting minutes are notes; minute as an adjective can mean very small.

words.meaning: a person who guides a discussion and ensures fair participation
words.example: The moderator invited questions from the audience after each panelist spoke.

words.meaning: to take part in an activity or discussion
words.example: Employees from both offices can participate in the remote workshop.

words.meaning: to arrange for an event to happen at a later time
words.example: Because the speaker's flight was delayed, organizers postponed the opening session.

words.meaning: a talk in which information is given to an audience
words.example: Her presentation compared customer retention across three regions.

words.meaning: a formal suggestion or plan put forward for consideration
words.example: The board requested a cost estimate before reviewing the proposal.

words.meaning: to advise that someone or something should be chosen or done
words.example: The consultant recommended extending the pilot program by two weeks.
words.tip: Use recommend + noun, recommend + -ing, or recommend that + clause.

words.meaning: to arrange an event for a different time
words.example: Could we reschedule the supplier call for Wednesday morning?

words.meaning: a period devoted to a particular activity at an event
words.example: The afternoon session focuses on data security for small businesses.

words.meaning: a person who gives a speech or presentation
words.example: The guest speaker shared lessons from the company's overseas expansion.

words.meaning: to express the main points of something briefly
words.example: Before closing, the chair summarized the decisions and assigned follow-up tasks.

words.meaning: the place where an event or meeting is held
words.example: The hotel was selected as the venue for the distributor conference.

words.meaning: to make information or meaning easier to understand
words.example: The analyst clarified which figures included the overseas branches.

words.meaning: to bring people together for a meeting
words.example: The safety committee will convene on the first Tuesday of each month.

words.meaning: to show how something works or to explain it with examples
words.example: A technician demonstrated the new video system before the conference began.

words.meaning: to stop someone while they are speaking or doing something
words.example: Please wait until the question period so you do not interrupt the presenter.

words.meaning: to make a formal choice by recording one's preference
words.example: Members will vote on the revised travel policy at the next meeting.
collocations: vote by a show of hands

lessons.title: Recruitment & Employment
lessons.description: Vocabulary for job applications, hiring decisions, workplace benefits, and career changes.
lessons.tip: Distinguish the people (applicant, candidate, employer) from the documents and stages of hiring.

words.meaning: a person who formally asks to be considered for a job or opportunity
words.example: Every applicant must provide two professional references.

words.meaning: a formal request for a job, place, or service
words.vietnameseMeaning: đơn xin; hồ sơ đăng ký
words.example: The online application asks candidates to list their recent work experience.

words.meaning: a person being considered for a position or award
words.example: The hiring panel invited its final candidate to meet the department head.

words.meaning: a person's work or professional life over time
words.example: A mentoring program helped new analysts plan their careers.

words.meaning: pay and other benefits received for work
words.vietnameseMeaning: thù lao; chế độ đãi ngộ
words.example: The compensation package includes health coverage and an annual bonus.

words.meaning: a document outlining a person's education, qualifications, and work history
words.vietnameseMeaning: sơ yếu lý lịch; hồ sơ nghề nghiệp
words.example: Please attach your curriculum vitae when replying to the research assistant posting.

words.meaning: a person who is paid to work for an organization
words.example: Each employee can choose a benefits plan during the enrollment period.

words.meaning: a person or organization that hires and pays workers
words.vietnameseMeaning: người sử dụng lao động; nhà tuyển dụng
words.example: The employer will reimburse relocation costs after the new manager starts.

words.meaning: the state of having paid work
words.example: The agency provides employment services to recent graduates.

words.meaning: a formal conversation used to assess a job candidate
words.example: The second interview will include a short presentation to the sales team.

words.meaning: an available position that an employer is seeking to fill
words.example: A job opening for a bilingual receptionist was posted on the company website.

words.meaning: a skill, experience, or credential that makes someone suitable for a role
words.vietnameseMeaning: trình độ; điều kiện chuyên môn
words.example: Fluency in German is a required qualification for the regional sales role.

words.meaning: to find and attract people to work for an organization
words.example: The firm plans to recruit three designers before the new product launch.

words.meaning: the process of finding and hiring new employees
words.vietnameseMeaning: việc tuyển dụng; quy trình tuyển dụng
words.example: Recruitment for seasonal warehouse positions begins in September.

words.meaning: a person who can describe someone's character or work; a statement about them
words.vietnameseMeaning: người tham chiếu; thư giới thiệu
words.example: The employer contacted her former supervisor for a reference.

words.meaning: a brief document describing a person's work experience and qualifications
words.vietnameseMeaning: sơ yếu lý lịch; hồ sơ xin việc
words.example: He revised his résumé to highlight his experience managing client accounts.
words.tip: A résumé is a job-history document; resume as a verb means continue.

words.meaning: fixed regular pay, usually stated as an annual amount
words.example: The advertised salary depends on the successful candidate's experience.

words.meaning: a final, reduced list of people being considered for a position
words.example: Three applicants made the shortlist for the operations director role.

words.meaning: an ability developed through training or experience
words.example: The position requires strong customer-service skills and accurate data entry.

words.meaning: the people who work for an organization
words.vietnameseMeaning: nhân viên; đội ngũ nhân sự
words.example: The hotel added temporary staff to handle the summer increase in bookings.
words.tip: Staff can refer to a group collectively or to individual staff members.

words.meaning: lasting for a limited time rather than permanently
words.example: A temporary assistant will cover the reception desk during the renovation.

words.meaning: an unoccupied position that is available to be filled
words.example: The company has a vacancy in its customer support department.

words.meaning: a review of a person's identity, history, or records
words.example: The final hiring stage includes a background check with the applicant's consent.

words.meaning: non-wage advantages provided by an employer, such as insurance or leave
words.example: Dental coverage is one of the benefits available to permanent employees.

words.meaning: to employ someone for a job
words.example: The studio hopes to hire a production coordinator by the end of the quarter.

words.meaning: the process of introducing a new employee to a job and organization
words.vietnameseMeaning: quy trình hội nhập nhân viên mới
words.example: Onboarding includes security training and an introduction to the product team.

words.meaning: a trial period at the start of employment during which suitability is assessed
words.example: New technicians complete a three-month probation before receiving a permanent contract.

words.meaning: advancement to a higher position or rank at work
words.example: Her promotion to regional manager takes effect on the first of June.

words.meaning: to formally leave a job by one's own decision
words.example: After accepting a role overseas, he gave notice that he would resign in May.

words.meaning: to end an employment agreement or other formal arrangement
words.example: The company may terminate the contract if the project is canceled.

lessons.title: Marketing & Advertising
lessons.description: Terms for promoting products, understanding customers, and measuring advertising reach.
lessons.tip: Advertising describes the paid message; a campaign is the coordinated effort across channels.

words.meaning: to promote a product, service, or event publicly
words.example: The company will advertise its summer internship program on university websites.

words.meaning: a public notice or message intended to promote something
words.example: The newspaper's advertisement lists the store's weekend hours and discounts.

words.meaning: the people a message, performance, or product is intended to reach
words.vietnameseMeaning: đối tượng khán giả; người xem
words.example: The campaign's audience includes first-time home buyers in the region.

words.meaning: a product or service identified by a particular name and image
words.example: The redesigned packaging gives the brand a more recognizable appearance.

words.meaning: a planned series of activities to achieve a marketing or public goal
words.example: A six-week campaign will introduce the updated delivery service to local businesses.

words.meaning: a paid advertisement shown on television, radio, or online video
words.vietnameseMeaning: quảng cáo trên truyền hình/phát thanh
words.example: The radio commercial directs listeners to the store's new website.

words.meaning: a person who buys or uses goods and services
words.example: Consumer feedback led the manufacturer to offer a smaller package size.

words.meaning: a voucher that allows a customer to receive a discount
words.example: Customers can present the coupon at checkout to save ten percent.

words.meaning: a group of people described by characteristics such as age or income
words.example: The survey compared purchasing habits across each demographic.

words.meaning: public support or approval, especially by a well-known person
words.vietnameseMeaning: sự chứng thực; lời quảng bá
words.example: The athlete's endorsement helped the company attract younger customers.

words.meaning: a display at a trade show or public event
words.vietnameseMeaning: gian trưng bày; vật trưng bày
words.example: Visitors can test the new payment terminals at the company's exhibit.

words.meaning: a notable or useful part of a product or service
words.example: A longer battery life is the feature customers mention most often.

words.meaning: a small printed sheet used to advertise or announce something
words.example: Volunteers distributed a flyer announcing the opening of the new branch.

words.meaning: the group of potential customers for a product or service
words.example: The company plans to enter the Canadian market next spring.
words.tip: Here market is a group of customers, not a physical marketplace.

words.meaning: the collection and analysis of information about customers and markets
words.example: Market research showed that commuters prefer a monthly transit pass.

words.meaning: the channels used to communicate news or advertising to the public
words.vietnameseMeaning: truyền thông; phương tiện truyền thông
words.example: The agency selected social media and local radio for the regional launch.
words.tip: Media is the plural form of medium, but is commonly treated as singular collectively.

words.meaning: the extent to which consumers recognize or remember a particular brand
words.example: The regional campaign increased brand awareness among first-time buyers.
words.tip: Brand awareness measures recognition; it does not necessarily mean a customer has made a purchase.

words.meaning: using or available through the internet
words.example: Customers can renew their memberships online without visiting a branch.
words.tip: Online is used as an adverb or adjective; this entry uses its adverb form.

words.meaning: to cause someone to agree or take action through reasoning or appeal
words.example: The sales presentation persuaded several distributors to try the new packaging.

words.meaning: the introduction of a new product to the market
words.example: The product launch is scheduled for the week before the industry expo.

words.meaning: a reduction from the usual price of a product or service
words.vietnameseMeaning: sự giảm giá; khoản chiết khấu
words.example: The retailer offered a discount to customers who ordered before the end of the month.

words.meaning: the work of managing an organization's public image and communication
words.example: Public relations staff prepared a statement about the new recycling program.

words.meaning: public attention or information that helps promote something
words.vietnameseMeaning: sự quảng bá; sự chú ý của công chúng
words.example: The charity event received positive publicity in the local business press.

words.meaning: the number or range of people exposed to a message
words.example: The newsletter's reach grew after the company added a mobile subscription option.
words.tip: Marketing reach counts people exposed to a message, not necessarily buyers.

words.meaning: a business that sells goods directly to consumers
words.example: The retailer will stock the new line in twenty stores this month.

words.meaning: a short, memorable phrase used in advertising or promotion
words.example: The agency tested three slogan options with a group of regular customers.

words.meaning: to provide money or support for an event or activity
words.example: A local bank agreed to sponsor the entrepreneurship conference.

words.meaning: a set of questions used to collect information or opinions
words.vietnameseMeaning: bản khảo sát; cuộc khảo sát
words.example: The customer survey asks shoppers to rate the new checkout process.

words.meaning: to direct a product or message toward a particular group
words.example: The retailer will target its email offer to customers who bought outdoor gear.

words.meaning: a statement from a customer describing a positive experience
words.vietnameseMeaning: lời chứng thực; nhận xét của khách hàng
words.example: The website features a testimonial from a client who uses the service daily.

lessons.title: Finance & Accounting
lessons.description: Essential terms for budgets, bookkeeping, business payments, and financial performance.
lessons.tip: Track whether a figure is money received, money spent, or an amount still owed.

words.meaning: a financial arrangement for recording money held or transactions made
words.example: The supplier asked the accounting team to verify its bank account details.

words.meaning: the work of recording and reporting an organization's financial activity
words.vietnameseMeaning: kế toán; công tác kế toán
words.example: Accounting closes the monthly books after all branch reports arrive.

words.meaning: a person whose job is to prepare or examine financial records
words.example: An accountant reviewed the expense claims before reimbursement.

words.meaning: the amount of money remaining in an account after additions and deductions
words.vietnameseMeaning: số dư; số dư tài khoản
words.example: The online statement shows a balance of $4,820 after the transfer.

words.meaning: a plan estimating income and spending over a period of time
words.example: The department revised its travel budget after airfare prices increased.

words.meaning: the movement of money into and out of a business
words.example: Seasonal cash flow improves when customers pay their invoices promptly.

words.meaning: an amount of money requested for a service or product
words.example: The hotel removed the room-service charge after correcting the billing error.
words.tip: A charge is a fee; charge can also be a verb meaning to bill someone.

words.meaning: money available to borrow or an amount added to an account
words.example: The returned equipment was recorded as a credit on the next statement.
words.tip: A credit may add funds to an account; credit can also mean borrowing capacity.

words.meaning: money that is owed to another person or organization
words.example: The company plans to repay its short-term debt before expanding the warehouse.

words.meaning: money placed into an account or paid in advance
words.example: A deposit is required to reserve the meeting rooms for the full week.

words.meaning: a cost incurred in doing business or completing an activity
words.example: The conference registration fee is a reimbursable business expense.

words.meaning: relating to money, finance, or the management of funds
words.example: The board requested a financial update before approving the expansion.

words.meaning: an estimate of a future amount or result based on current information
words.example: The finance team revised its sales projection after receiving the latest orders from distributors.
words.tip: A financial projection is an estimate, not a confirmed result.

words.meaning: money received, especially by a business or person
words.example: Rental income helped cover the maintenance costs of the office building.
words.tip: Income is money received; revenue usually refers to an organization's business income.

words.meaning: a document listing goods or services supplied and the amount due
words.example: Please attach the purchase order number to the invoice before sending it.
words.tip: An invoice requests payment; a receipt confirms payment was received.

words.meaning: a book or digital record containing financial accounts
words.example: The bookkeeper entered the adjustment in the general ledger.

words.meaning: money borrowed that must be repaid, usually with interest
words.example: The company obtained a low-interest loan to purchase delivery vehicles.

words.meaning: a financial amount by which costs exceed income
words.example: The retailer reported a small loss after closing two underperforming stores.

words.meaning: the difference between a product's selling price and its cost
words.example: A lower shipping rate would improve the profit margin on each order.
words.tip: Profit margin is commonly expressed as a percentage of sales.

words.meaning: money given to settle an amount owed or to buy something
words.example: The final payment is due within thirty days of installation.

words.meaning: the process or total amount of paying an organization's employees
words.example: Payroll will process the overtime adjustments on Friday.

words.meaning: the money remaining when business costs are subtracted from income
words.example: Higher service revenue increased the firm's profit for the quarter.

words.meaning: a document authorizing a seller to provide specified goods or services
words.example: The vendor cannot ship the monitors until it receives a purchase order.

words.meaning: a financial statement showing an organization?s assets, liabilities, and equity at a particular date
words.example: The auditors compared the balance sheet with the year-end account records.
words.tip: A balance sheet reports financial position at a specific point in time.

words.meaning: a cost incurred through the normal day-to-day activities of running a business
words.example: The company reduced its operating expenses by consolidating two regional offices.
words.tip: Operating expenses are deducted from revenue when calculating operating income.

words.meaning: a document showing transactions and the amount due or available
words.example: The bank statement lists the wire transfer made on Monday.
words.tip: A bank statement summarizes account activity over a period.

words.meaning: money required by the government on income, goods, or property
words.example: The finance team calculated sales tax for every regional office.

words.meaning: an instance of buying, selling, or transferring money or goods
words.example: The system flagged the duplicate transaction for review.

words.meaning: an electronic transfer of money from one bank account to another, often across banks or countries
words.example: The overseas supplier requested payment by wire transfer before releasing the replacement parts.
words.tip: A wire transfer sends funds electronically between bank accounts; check the recipient details before payment.

words.meaning: to take money out of an account
words.example: Managers can withdraw petty cash after signing the office ledger.
